name: haiku
description: HAIKU chatroom: tools to join/send/read HAIKU rooms, plus a hook that catches a session up on unread room events each turn.

daemonUrl.title: Daemon URL
daemonUrl.description: Base URL of the HAIKU daemon (daemon/server.py).

participantName.title: Participant name
participantName.description: This session's HAIKU participant name. Register it with the daemon first (see README) before setting this.

participantToken.title: Participant token
participantToken.description: This session's HAIKU participant token, from registration. Never shared across participants.
